map.位移变化量与所用时间之比。: The ratio of displacement change to elapsed time.
map.位移除以时间得平均速度。: Displacement divided by time gives average velocity.
map.行程整体快慢评估。: Overall speed/duration evaluation of a trip.
map.按位移与时间的比值求平均速度，区别于平均速率。: Find average velocity by the ratio of displacement to time, distinct from average speed.
map.v̄ = 100/10 = 10 m/s。即 10 秒走 100 米，平均 10: v̄ = 100/10 = 10 m/s. That is, 100 m in 10 s, average 10 m/s (does not reflect mid-trip speed).
map.v̄=Δx/Δt=180/6=30.000 m/s，换算为 108.000 km: v̄=Δx/Δt=180/6=30.000 m/s, converted to 108.000 km/h (multiply by 3.6).
map.平均是总位移/总时间；瞬时是某时刻速率。变速运动时两者常不同。: Average is total displacement / total time; instantaneous is the speed at a moment. Under variable motion the two often differ.
map.平均速度和平均速率有什么不同？: What is the difference between average velocity and average speed?
map.平均速度用位移（起点到终点的直线距离，含方向），平均速率用路程（实际走过的轨迹长: Average velocity uses displacement (straight-line distance from start to end, with direction); average speed uses distance traveled (actual path length). Running one lap around a track back to the start, displacement is 0 so average velocity is 0, but average speed is not 0 — this tool strictly computes the former.
